Prior to the initial Disbursement of Program Funding to the GP Facility, MCA-Indonesia developed the Operations Manual consistent with the requirements of Annex I, Schedule 1, Section 1(c) of the Compact and Schedule 5 of this Agreement.

Prior to the initial Disbursement of Program Funding to the GP Facility, MCA-Indonesia shall have designed and established an ESMS consistent with the requirements of Annex I, Schedule 1, Section 3 of the Compact, and reflected applicable requirements of Annex I, Schedule 1 of the Compact in the Operations Manual.
